slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint that a product cannot start on a later machine until it has finished on the previous machine (i.e., product i must complete on Machine 1 before starting on Machine 2, and complete on Machine 2 before starting on Machine 3), or can a product be processed on multiple machines simultaneously?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product must follow the sequential machine order 1→2→3, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the schedule — are we minimizing the total time until all three products are completely finished (the makespan), or minimizing something else such as total idle time or total flow time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked for clarification of the objective and explicitly offered makespan as an interpretation, satisfying the semantic hit rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL: the objective was clarified as makespan in turn 7, and the sequential machine order was confirmed in turn 3. Remaining unresolved items were P2 or non-hidden details.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the objective (makespan) and the sequential machine-order constraint—before stopping, and it explicitly flagged its assumption about machine capacity. The interaction was efficient and appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
